title: Professional Men and Women Group Gathering, 1969 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An indoor black-and-white group portrait stamped June 1969 showing an integrated group of men and women dressed in formal business attire, posing together in a room with striped wallpaper. The men wear tailored suits, ties, and name badges, while the woman in the center wears a dress with a dark floral lace overlay and a corsage, standing beside another woman in a striped cardigan jacket and shift dress. The image reflects late 1960s professional networking and community leadership.
